heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy, with a chance of showers mainly east of the Greens. Lows in the 40s, near 50 far south. Light north wind.

heading: Saturday
text: Mostly cloudy, with rain showers. A brief period of midday clearing in the east, with additional showers in the afternoon. Highs in the 50s north, increasing to near 60 in the south. Wind turning northeast at 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Saturday Night
text: Scattered to numerous showers. Cooler. Lows in the 30s, upper 30s and low 40s south. Light wind turning northwest near 10 mph.
